Out of window and not stories: Cotality October Home Value Index (page metadata 2 November), ABS September building approvals (2 November), the trust tax Senate hearing (early November), the RBA decision (3 November).
ai_notes: AI scan 8 November 2026 for 26 October to 1 November 2026, after the profile was fixed. Searched: Australian AI regulation and guidance (AI standards legislation, Joint Select Committee on AI, OAIC, Safe Work Australia), HIA and Master Builders AI items, peer builders (volume home builders, Lendlease, Stockland, Mirvac, FBR), construction AI vendors (Procore press page, Buildxact, Autodesk), Microsoft 365 Copilot updates, council and state AI planning tools, a November 2026 construction AI roundup. Found in window: DAISY council AI planning assistant (A1, not must: it serves residents and small builders through councils, not this builder's own tools or rules). In window but not material: Oracle NetSuite construction AI agents (26 October, not a profile tool), Bedrock Robotics funding (26 October, US earthmoving), Online Safety (Digital Duty of Care) bill passing the House (28 October, chatbots and children, not this industry). Out of window (stale SA1 to SA5): Procore AI Go (21 October), Safe Work Australia AI guidance (July), FBR Hadrian H04 demonstration (5 October), Togal.AI takeoff benchmark (6 October), Copilot Credits billing (by 1 October). No AI regulation, guidance or peer builder AI move dated in the window was found, so no must AI story.
key_writer: Separate key writer for ticket 29; saw no Copilot answer, no prompt and no run; profile (case-t2/profile.md) written at 23:29 AEST on 8 November 2026, before the AI scan.

stories.what: ABS Consumer Price Index for September 2026, released 28 October 2026: CPI up 4.3% over the year; new dwelling prices up 4.7% over the year (5.4% to August), flat in the month, with builders using discounts as demand slows. Echoed by Master Builders and many outlets: one story.

evidence.quote: New dwelling prices rose 4.7% in the 12 months to September 2026, down from a 5.4% rise to August 2026.

stories.what: ABS Producer Price Indexes for the September quarter 2026, released 30 October 2026: input costs for house construction up 1.0% in the quarter and 3.9% over the year, the fastest annual rise in three years. Echoed by Master Builders and outlets: one story.

evidence.quote: In the 12 months to September, input costs for house construction increased by 3.9 per cent.

stories.what: HIA Affordability Report for the September quarter 2026, released 28 October 2026: the index improved 3.6% as dwelling prices fell, but affordability is still 5.4% worse than a year earlier.

evidence.quote: The HIA Affordability Index increased by 3.6 per cent in the September quarter 2026, reflecting improved affordability across most markets.
evidence.page_date_source: page text (Wednesday 28 October 2026); the page metadata says 2026-10-27, also in the window

stories.what: Enterprise AI's DAISY, an AI planning assistant on NSW council websites that guides residents and home builders through development application rules, went live at City of Newcastle and Muswellbrook, with 16,533 conversations from January to September 2026; reported 29 October 2026. Echoes are one story.

evidence.quote: Between January and September 2026, DAISY recorded 16,533 conversations across live council deployments.

stories.what: Microsoft published its October 2026 update for Microsoft 365 Copilot on 30 October 2026: Home brings Chat and Cowork together with scheduled automations, role-based Cowork plugins (sales, legal and finance, including contract review against a playbook), accounting and clean data skills in Excel, and Autopilot, an always-on personal agent, rolling out to Frontier in November. Echoes are one story.

evidence.quote: Autopilot is an always-on, cloud-based personal agent that takes work off users’ plates and keeps it moving without them having to direct every step.
evidence.page_date_note: JSON-LD datePublished '10/30/2026, 3:30:00 PM' read as 30 October 2026 (ruler v10.1 US n/n/yyyy rule); quote and date checked live 9 November 2026

stale.what: Queensland Infrastructure Activation Fund ($2.4 billion) opens to applications (19 October 2026).
HIA Housing 100 report for 2025/26 (21 October 2026): largest builders completed 70,553 homes, 35% of the market.
Master Builders opposes the Secure Australian Jobs Framework and Supplier Code changes (22 October 2026).
HIA new home sales slump and 2025/26 commencements (16 October 2026).
Master Builders construction forecasts marked down (1 October 2026).
Trust tax legislation introduced; Master Builders says it fails the sector's concerns (14 October 2026).
ABS Labour Force for September 2026 (15 October): unemployment rate up to 4.7%; construction workforce shortfall projection.
Joint ministerial meeting on housing supply and affordability communique (16 October 2026): record 248,733 homes under construction.
ABS building approvals for August 2026 (dwelling approvals up 10.3% over the year), re-reported by a trade outlet on 30 October 2026.
Procore launches Procore AI Go, a voice-first AI mobile app for jobsite crews, at Groundbreak (21 October 2026).
Safe Work Australia guidance on managing work health and safety risks from AI and digital technologies (July 2026).
FBR's Hadrian H04 bricklaying robot completes its first Australian residential demonstration build (5 October 2026).
Togal.AI 'Construction's Last Exam' benchmark: general AI models score 2% to 34% on construction takeoff tasks (6 October 2026).
Microsoft 365 Copilot pricing moves to a per-user licence plus usage-based Copilot Credits, rolling out from Q4 2026 (Message Center notice, by 1 October 2026).
